g.text: Curve height: position density. Ticks: individual positions. Dashed outlines: original views. Shared scales across all rows.

g.text: Each row contains 240 constructed positions; mirrored samples deliberately give every distribution a mean of zero.

g.text: DESIGN SIMULATION — NOT RESULTS. Rows 2–3 illustrate positions reconstructed by readers from hypothetical summaries,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #877e92

g.text: not distributions directly measured from prose. A real study must collect blinded reader reconstructions. No models or readers were tested.
